name: heavy-bomber
title: Heavy bomber (mission 1 raid)
usage: Mission 1: six bombers in formation (required targets, never fire). Pending review; not referenced from src/.

noText.note: No letters, numbers, call signs, serials, squadron codes or glyph-like marks in mesh or texture; grey countershading, splinter camouflage, panel lines and stains only.

noLogosOrBrands.note: No company, product or brand marks; colour fields and wear only.

noRealMilitaryInsignia.note: No roundels, flags, national or unit markings; the only markings are a plain dark-red fin-tip band and plain rings on the engine lips. Airframe is an original design, not a copy of any real or game aircraft (podded turbofans, shoulder wing, low tailplanes).

noFaces.note: No faces or figures: no crew is modelled. Head-on (review 1 rejected export 1 for a face-like front) the nose is a long pointed radome in the body colour with no seam ring, dark panel or camouflage; the windscreen is a grid of separate small panes in body-colour frames, tinted only slightly lighter than the paint; nothing protrudes from the nose, cheeks or lower corners (no probe, pitot, chin blister or gear sponsons), so the head-on fuselage outline is a plain oval. Engine fronts are four small fan discs spread along the wings. Checked in preview-front, preview-closeup-front, preview-closeup-front-3q, preview-front-low and preview-closeup-front-low.

noSuggestiveShapes.note: Ordinary hard-surface or natural forms reviewed in all four previews.

noGoreOrWeaponsGlorification.note: Unarmed airframe: no guns, turret, missiles or visible bombs; bomb-bay doors are closed panel lines. No kill marks, damage or gore.

originalDesign.note: Authored procedurally in tools/assets from original dimensions; no third-party meshes or scans.

design: Original four-turbofan heavy bomber: pointed radome, shoulder-mounted 33-degree swept wing, slight anhedral, podded engines on pylons, swept fin, low tailplanes, gear housed inside the fuselage. 72 studs span = 2.9x Vanta v2 (24.6) and 3.2x Kestrel v2 (22.2).
revision: heavy-bomber-2 (review 1 rejected heavy-bomber-1 for a face-like head-on view): pointed body-colour radome without seam ring, anti-glare panel or nose camouflage; windscreen as separate light panes; refuelling probe, pitot, chin radar blister, nose lights and gear sponsons removed; no longeron or spine lines on the nose cone.
reviewStatus: pending independent safety review (AGENTS.md); not uploaded; not referenced from src/

scaleReference.note: Review aid only: an approved, already uploaded asset placed at in-game size for scale. Not part of this asset or its FBX.
